caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular field filled with a repeating pattern of swirling, organic shapes resembling stylized leaves and floral motifs. The background is a light, off-white color, while the patterns are rendered in bright hues of red, blue, green, pink, and brown. There are several wavy lines composed of leaf-like segments in light green and red running vertically near the left and right edges and through the center. Scattered throughout the design are smaller shapes that echo the same colors—red, blue, brown, and green—each formed in rounded or jagged-edge patterns, some resembling small blossoms or buds. The overall layout is symmetrical, with the same types of shapes mirrored on either side of the vertical center. The border is a simple outlined edge with a pinkish-red linear decoration, which frames the entire composition.
title: Colcha
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
